accuracyFlags: 'Queenstown Lakes District enforces freedom camping restrictions strictly, with defined zones, certification requirements': vague; Kiwi blue self-containment warrants are no longer recognised since 7 June 2026, so any certification wording must reflect the current rule and be sourced to QLDC/NZ Government
'Allow well over an hour each way' and '45 kilometres': Glenorchy is about 45 km from Queenstown; fine, but unsourced

DOC sites 'Twelve Mile Delta and Moke Lake': DOC lists Moke Lake as its conservation campsite (bookings required); Twelve Mile Delta operator is disputed in sources, so verify before asserting fees or pass use
